cases.input:
<FLOAD "77loadall.mud">
<SETG TR-NAMES ["READSTRING" "VALUE" "BOUND?" "ASSIGNED?" "GBOUND?" "GASSIGNED?" "GUNASSIGN" "SET" "TYPE" "PRIMTYPE" "TYPEPRIM" "CHTYPE" "ALLTYPES" "VALID-TYPE?" "NEWTYPE" "EVALTYPE" "APPLYTYPE" "PRINTTYPE" "LENGTH" "REST" "GET" "SUBSTRUC" "LIST" "FORM" "VECTOR" "TUPLE" "UVECTOR" "STRING" "ILIST" "IFORM" "IVECTOR" "IUVECTOR" "ISTRING" "PUTREST" "CONS" "BACK" "TOP" "SORT" "UTYPE" "CHUTYPE" "ASCII" "PARSE" "UNPARSE" "EXPAND" "EVAL" "MAPF" "MAPR" "1?" "G?" "L?" "G=?" "L=?" "==?" "N==?" "=?" "N=?" "MEMBER" "MEMQ" "STRCOMP" "*" "-" "/" "MIN" "MAX" "MOD" "RANDOM" "FLOAT" "FIX" "ABS" "GETPROP" "PUTPROP" "MOBLIST" "OBLIST?" "LOOKUP" "ATOM" "REMOVE" "INSERT" "PNAME" "SPNAME" "ROOT" "BLOCK" "ENDBLOCK" "NOT" "AND?" "OR?" "TYPE?" "APPLICABLE?" "MONAD?" "STRUCTURED?" "EMPTY?" "LENGTH?" "CHANNEL" "OPEN" "FILE-EXISTS?" "CLOSE" "RESET" "ACCESS" "READ" "READCHR" "NEXTCHR" "PRINT" "PRIN1" "PRINC" "TERPRI" "FLATSIZE" "CRLF" "READB" "PRINTB" "PRINTSTRING" "IMAGE" "LOAD" "FLOAD" "SNAME" "SAVE" "SAVE-EVAL" "RESTORE" "FILE-LENGTH" "DECL?" "ERROR" "BITS" "GETBITS" "PUTBITS" "ANDB" "ORB" "XORB" "EQVB" "LSH" "GC" "TIME" "LOGOUT" "GETTIMEOFDAY" "GETTIMEDATE" "MANIFEST" "FREEZE" "BLOAT" "OFF" "EVENT" "HANDLER" "ON" "ENABLE" "DISABLE" "INT-LEVEL" "SLEEP" "WARRANTY" "COPYING"]>
<SETG TR-N <LENGTH ,TR-NAMES>>
<SETG TR-CNT <IVECTOR ,TR-N 0>>
<SETG TR-FIRST <IVECTOR ,TR-N -1>>
<SETG TR-ORD <IVECTOR ,TR-N 0>>
<SETG TR-SEQ 0>
<SETG TR-ON <>>
<DEFINE TR-HIT (I) <COND (,TR-ON <COND (<0? <NTH ,TR-CNT .I>> <PUT ,TR-FIRST .I <NTH ,TR-CNT 1>> <SETG TR-SEQ <+ ,TR-SEQ 1>> <PUT ,TR-ORD .I ,TR-SEQ>)> <PUT ,TR-CNT .I <+ <NTH ,TR-CNT .I> 1>>)> T>
<DEFINE TR-MK (I ORIG) <CHTYPE <LIST '("TUPLE" TRARGS) <FORM TR-HIT .I> <FORM APPLY <FORM QUOTE .ORIG> <CHTYPE <FORM LVAL TRARGS> SEGMENT>>> FUNCTION>>
<SETG TR-W <IVECTOR ,TR-N <>>>
<SETG TR-A <IVECTOR ,TR-N <>>>
<PROG ((I 1) A) <REPEAT () <COND (<G? .I ,TR-N> <RETURN T>)> <SET A <LOOKUP <NTH ,TR-NAMES .I> <ROOT>>> <COND (<AND .A <GASSIGNED? .A> <TYPE? ,.A SUBR>> <PUT ,TR-A .I .A> <PUT ,TR-W .I <TR-MK .I ,.A>>)> <SET I <+ .I 1>>>>
<SETG TR-QUIT ,QUIT>
<DEFINE TR-DUMP ("TUPLE" X) <SETG TR-ON <>> <PROG ((I 1)) <REPEAT () <COND (<G? .I ,TR-N> <RETURN T>)> <COND (<NTH ,TR-A .I> <PRINC "@@TRACE "> <PRINC <NTH ,TR-NAMES .I>> <PRINC " "> <PRIN1 <NTH ,TR-CNT .I>> <PRINC " "> <PRIN1 <NTH ,TR-FIRST .I>> <PRINC " "> <PRIN1 <NTH ,TR-ORD .I>> <CRLF>)> <SET I <+ .I 1>>>> <APPLY ,TR-QUIT>>
<PROG ((I 1)) <REPEAT () <COND (<G? .I ,TR-N> <RETURN T>)> <COND (<NTH ,TR-A .I> <SETG <NTH ,TR-A .I> <NTH ,TR-W .I>>)> <SET I <+ .I 1>>>>
<SETG QUIT ,TR-DUMP>
<SETG TR-ON T>
<SAVE-IT>
north
west
open mailbox
take leaflet
inventory
score
quit
y
